names.iupac: [3-(2-dimethylaminoethyl)-1H-indol-4-yl] dihydrogen phosphate (psilocybin, as given by EUDA)
names.formula: C12H17N2O4P (NIST; PubChem CID 10624). The EUDA profile prints 'C12H17N204P', with the digit 0 where NIST and PubChem have the letter O.

forms.detail: 3-(2-dimethylaminoethyl)-1H-indol-4-ol (EUDA IUPAC name), also 4-hydroxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (4-OH-DMT), psilocine, psilocyn. CAS 520-53-6 (EUDA; NIST). Formula C12H16N2O (NIST; PubChem CID 4980); the EUDA profile prints 'C12H16N20'. Molar mass 204.2682 (NIST); 204.3 g/mol (EUDA). DEA spells it 'psilocyn'.
EUDA names baeocystin and norbaeocystin (no further identifiers).

EUDA: more than 50 species, in the genera Psilocybe, Panaeolus and Copelandia; it names Psilocybe cubensis (cultivated, mostly in the Netherlands) and Psilocybe tampensis (in a grow-kit description). DEA names the genus Psilocybe.

forms.form: Fresh, dried or otherwise preserved mushrooms
forms.detail: EUDA: fresh mushrooms, or treated/preserved (e.g. deliberately dried, cooked, frozen); DEA: mushrooms, also in tea or in foods.
EUDA: spore prints, spawnbags and grow kits, and by-products.
